attributes.name: word_count
attributes.title: Word count
attributes.question: How many words are on the page?

attributes.name: reading_grade
attributes.title: Reading level
attributes.question: What school grade does the copy read at?

attributes.name: cta_count
attributes.title: How many CTAs
attributes.question: How many calls to action are on the page?

attributes.name: number_count
attributes.title: Numbers in the copy
attributes.question: How many numbers appear in the copy?

attributes.name: opening_framing
attributes.title: Opening angle
attributes.question: What does the page lead with in its opening lines?

options.problem: a pain point, risk or frustration the reader has
options.product: what the product is or does, or a category label

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.title: Main claim
attributes.question: What is the page's main claim?

options.category: names a new or better category, such as an operating system or platform
options.outcome: promises a specific result for the reader
options.capability: describes features and what the product can do

attributes.name: audience
attributes.title: Audience
attributes.question: Who is the page addressed to?

options.specific_role: one named role or job title

attributes.name: proof_type
attributes.title: Strongest proof type
attributes.question: What is the strongest proof on the page?

options.logos_or_names: customer or investor names without a quote

attributes.name: tone
attributes.title: Tone
attributes.question: What best describes the tone?

attributes.name: hero_style
attributes.title: Hero style
attributes.question: What dominates the top of the page?

options.product_ui: screenshots or mockups of the product
options.text_only: mostly text on a plain background

attributes.name: cta_prominence
attributes.title: CTA prominence
attributes.question: How prominent is the main call to action?

options.high: large or high-contrast, and the eye goes to it quickly
options.medium: visible but competes with other elements

attributes.name: visual_density
attributes.title: Visual density
attributes.question: How dense is the top of the page?

attributes.name: proof_in_view
attributes.title: Proof visible without scrolling
attributes.question: Is customer proof, such as logos or quotes, visible in this screenshot?

attributes.name: headline_length
attributes.title: Headline length
attributes.question: How many words are in the headline?

attributes.name: image_count
attributes.title: Number of images
attributes.question: How many images are in the page's code? Icons are skipped.

attributes.name: video_count
attributes.title: Number of videos
attributes.question: How many videos are in the page's code?

attributes.name: section_count
attributes.title: Number of sections
attributes.question: How many sections does the page have?

attributes.name: page_length
attributes.title: Page length
attributes.question: How many screens long is the page?

attributes.name: video_on_page
attributes.title: Video on page
attributes.question: Is there a video, and where does the first one sit?

options.top: in the first third of the page

attributes.name: primary_color
attributes.title: Primary color
attributes.question: What color covers the most of the page?

attributes.name: background
attributes.title: Light or dark background
attributes.question: Is the page mostly light or dark?

attributes.name: cta_wording
attributes.title: CTA wording
attributes.question: What does the first call to action say?

attributes.name: form_on_page
attributes.title: Form on the page
attributes.question: Is there a form on the page?

attributes.name: sentiment
attributes.title: Sentiment score
attributes.question: What is the overall sentiment of the copy?

options.negative: focused on pain, risk or loss

attributes.name: people_in_images
attributes.title: People in images
attributes.question: Do photos or images of people appear anywhere on the page?

attributes.name: product_in_images
attributes.title: Product in images
attributes.question: Do screenshots or mockups of the product appear anywhere on the page?

attributes.name: customer_logos
attributes.title: Customer logos
attributes.question: How many customer logos appear on the page?

attributes.name: security_badges
attributes.title: Security or compliance badges
attributes.question: Do security or compliance badges appear, such as SOC 2 or GDPR?

attributes.name: cta_color
attributes.title: CTA color family
attributes.question: What color is the main CTA button?

attributes.name: cta_contrast
attributes.title: CTA contrast
attributes.question: How strongly does the main CTA button stand out from what is behind it? 1 is none, 21 is the most.
